name: Input
purpose: A single-line text field with its label, hint and error tied to it for screen readers.

props.label: string shown above the field; also its accessible name
props.hint: ReactNode under the field, e.g. the expected format
props.error: string: marks the field invalid, is announced, replaces the hint
every <input> attribute except size (value, onChange, type, placeholder, disabled)

usage: <Input label="Quantity" type="number" error={tooMany ? 'Only 4 are in store' : undefined} />
rules: Always give a label; use the placeholder for an example only, never instead of the label.
Error text says what is wrong and how to fix it, in one sentence.
